question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

claims.text: Trade press (WealthManagement.com, 2026-11-12) reports Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp., expanding its relationship with Pinnacle Financial Partners; the advisors are expected to transition in May 2027. FID president Stephen Kruchten called it "a significant and highly strategic expansion" of the relationship.

InvestmentNews (2026-11-06) reports Raymond James & Associates (RJA), the employee advisor channel, landed a Washington, D.C. team (KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown) from PNC Private Bank that managed over $1.5 billion in client assets; the article adds that RJA had announced a $700 million team earlier that week, the second in as many weeks at that size.

InvestmentNews (2026-11-06) also reports that Ameriprise welcomed back Ricardo Baptiste, who has $193 million in client assets, after a six-year stint at Raymond James (a departure from Raymond James).

InvestmentNews (2026-11-05) reports two Virginia advisors (Mintz & Gow Group) joined RJA from Truist Investment Services with more than $1.2 billion in client assets. The article says Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, up 2% year-over-year, and has signaled it expects continued momentum with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments. This conflicts with WealthManagement.com (2026-10-29), which says Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount and had about 8,900 advisors when it last broke it out.

InvestmentNews (2026-11-05) says the Richmond hire is the latest in a sustained Raymond James recruitment drive, citing earlier-in-the-year teams from Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley and a $420 million Edward Jones team in Virginia late last year.

InvestmentNews (2026-11-04) reports RJA welcomed a four-advisor team from UBS Financial Services in Beachwood, Ohio (42° North Advisors of Raymond James) that managed more than $700 million; the team cited Raymond James's reputation, stability and leadership as deciding factors.

WealthManagement.com (2026-10-29), reporting on the fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call, says Raymond James reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year. The Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year, and pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year.

WealthManagement.com (2026-10-29) reports domestic PCG net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion; quarterly net new assets were nearly $23 billion, with annualized growth from the beginning of the quarter of 5.3%.

WealthManagement.com (2026-10-29) reports non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.59, which it says beat analysts' expectations by $0.32 according to Seeking Alpha, on revenue of $4.74 billion, up 13% year-over-year.

On the fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call (reported 2026-10-29), CEO Paul Shoukry said trailing 12-month production for recruited advisors entering the domestic independent contractor and employee channels was $538 million, up from $407 million the prior year, representing more than $82 billion in client assets. He said recruiting success spans all affiliation channels, including RIA custody, with the independent contractor channel seeing the most interest in dollar volume.

On M&A (reported 2026-10-29), Shoukry said the firm looks for wealth management acquisitions in particular, but they must be a good cultural and strategic fit: "We don't do acquisitions to slash costs... We do acquisitions to grow revenues and to be better firms together over time."

WealthManagement.com (2026-10-23) reports Raymond James recruited a Southwest Florida team managing about $700 million from Truist Investment Services into its Financial Institutions Division (via Pinnacle Asset Management); it describes FID as established in 1987 and serving about 950 advisors across 160 institutions.

Departure: WealthManagement.com (2026-10-16) reports Janney Montgomery Scott is opening a Houston office seeded by the Edward Fitzpatrick Group, which had been with Raymond James about 23 years and amassed $3.3 billion in client assets, plus an advisor overseeing more than $200 million.

Departure: WealthManagement.com (2026-10-08) reports four practices with more than $1 billion in client assets left Raymond James Financial Services for Ascentis Independent Advisors, an RIA platform, and will continue to use Raymond James as their primary custodian.

InvestmentNews and WealthManagement.com (2026-09-29) report Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework combining equity and fixed income with a dedicated alternatives sleeve (private markets and hedged strategies) for advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients. PCG President Tash Elwyn said the firm is "committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors." Asset Management Services builds the models with the Private Markets and Alternatives team.

InvestmentNews (2026-09-29) reports nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation (launched September 2022) as of September 2026. It also recounts that Raymond James agreed in January 2026 to acquire Clark Capital Management Group (more than $46 billion under management), which closed in May 2026 and joined Raymond James Investment Management as an independent boutique.

InvestmentNews (2026-09-29) notes that Shoukry has emphasized building advisory ranks through individualized one-on-one recruitment rather than large-scale acquisitions, and that the firm is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond.

WealthManagement.com and InvestmentNews (2026-09-24) report Raymond James added a $1.25 billion Iowa team (Greenwood Wealth Partners, from D.M. Kelly) to its employee channel and a $500 million Rochester, N.Y. team (Harris Wealth Partners, from Commonwealth Financial Network) to its independent channel. WealthManagement.com says Raymond James has been one of the most significant beneficiaries of teams leaving Commonwealth ahead of its LPL conversion and has boosted recruitment spending over the past year, according to earnings reports.

WealthManagement.com (2026-09-16) reports, citing a regulatory filing and a spokesperson, that Raymond James made a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program, partnered with Capital Group American Funds, available to its roughly 8,900 advisors for small businesses with up to 100 employees.
InvestmentNews (2026-09-02) reports RJA added a team from UBS Financial Services in The Woodlands, Texas (Le Sage Mattiza Maggard Wealth Management) that previously managed more than $550 million.

InvestmentNews (2026-08-26) reports Jeffrey Stillwell, with approximately $240 million from Ameriprise Financial Services, affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services in Red Bank, New Jersey, citing investment banking access and lending solutions for business-owner clients.

InvestmentNews (2026-08-21) reports RJA welcomed Adam Pearsall from UBS, who managed more than $400 million, in Glens Falls, New York; a division director cited continued investment in the Capital Region.
InvestmentNews (2026-08-19) reports Raymond James Financial Services welcomed Roberto De Jesus from Edward Jones after 18 years, with approximately $199 million in client assets, in Acworth, Georgia.

Outlook: InvestmentNews (2026-11-05) says Raymond James "has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year"; this is the trade press's characterization, not management's quoted guidance.

adjacent.text: InvestmentNews (2026-10-19) reports a FINRA arbitration panel awarded Raymond James $16.4 million in compensatory damages and accrued interest against Deutsche Bank Securities over revenue-share payments on 10 commercial loans, and that two former advisors (Kuras and Marsh) separately received $1.23 million and $628,000 in the matter.
adjacent.differs_because: This is a legal/arbitration outcome, not an acquisition, leadership, capital deployment or strategic initiative announcement; it is trade-press reporting, which is indicative, not authoritative.

gaps.what: Raymond James's own earnings release, call transcript or filing for the fiscal fourth quarter was not in the evidence; results are reported only via trade press (WealthManagement.com), so total net revenue, net income, margins and segment detail beyond PCG are not found.
gaps.suggested_source: Raymond James fiscal Q4 2026 earnings release, earnings call transcript and Form 10-K

gaps.what: No leadership changes or capital deployment items (buybacks, dividends, acquisitions announced in the window) were found in the evidence for this period.
gaps.suggested_source: Raymond James press releases, 8-Ks and fiscal Q4 2026 earnings call transcript (capital management section)

gaps.what: No evidence on Capital Markets, Raymond James Bank (e.g., net interest income, loan growth) or Asset Management segment results for the window, and no formal management outlook or guidance quoted from the call.
